customer_name: Beijing Shijingshan District (北京市石景山区)
business_problem: Shijingshan District wanted to turn broad interest in AI into an operating model that local enterprises, developers, and talent programs could actually use, but it lacked a shared platform to combine tooling, training, ecosystem activity, and vertical-industry scenario incubation.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Shijingshan District set up the Beijing Qianfan Large Model Industry Innovation Base as a public-service engine for local AI adoption. Instead of centering on one municipal workflow, the base combines a technical platform, enterprise incubation, talent cultivation, and scenario-opening activities so local organizations can get both tools and guidance. Qianfan development and application capabilities form the platform core, while the surrounding operating model is organized as 'one base, three engines': a public AI service engine for model tools, an industry engine for enterprise collaboration and scenario incubation, and a talent engine for practical training. This structure lets the district connect local firms that already experiment with PaddlePaddle and other AI resources to a more complete path for workshops, joint product creation, and large-model pilots in manufacturing, education, healthcare, energy, transport, finance, culture, and city management.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Model Development Platform
solution_components.role: Provides large-model development tools for enterprises and developers participating in the district's innovation base.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Application Development Platform
solution_components.role: Lets local users turn large-model capabilities into AI-native applications within the public-service base.

solution_components.name: Large Model Industry Innovation Base
solution_components.role: Acts as the operational center for local enterprise incubation, scenario opening, and AI ecosystem events.

solution_components.name: AI Talent Engine
solution_components.role: Delivers practical training programs so local talent can learn and adopt large-model tools.

data_flow: Local enterprise and developer needs are funneled into the innovation base, where Qianfan tools provide model-development and application-building capabilities. Training programs, scenario incubation, and public events then feed talent, prototypes, and pilot projects back into district industries such as manufacturing, healthcare, finance, transport, and city management.
business_outcome: Shijingshan gained a reusable district-level AI operating model that helps local firms access tools, scenario incubation, and training without building every enabling capability themselves.
metrics: Two Baidu AI product-launch events had already been held in Shougang Park by early 2024.
Baidu committed to holding 4 high-quality forums and exchange events in the district each year.
architecture_clues: The base is organized around a 'one base, three engines' operating model rather than one standalone software application.
The program explicitly combines enterprise incubation, public events, tooling, and talent programs.
Target verticals include manufacturing, education, healthcare, energy, transport, finance, culture, and city management.
evidence_quotes: Shijingshan built the country's first Baidu Qianfan large-model industry innovation base (original: 全国首个百度智能云千帆大模型产业创新基地落地).
The base is meant to provide a technical platform, enterprise incubation, and talent cultivation (original: 包括搭建大模型技术平台、孵化运营平台场景，引进与孵化科技企业，以及引进与培育人才等).
Baidu describes the model as 'one base, three engines' (original: 通过"一基地三引擎"服务模式，营造人工智能创新创业氛围).
Baidu committed to four quality forums or exchange events each year in the district (original: 百度将保障每年在石景山区举办4场优质论坛及交流活动).
